description: Separate Workflow task completion policy (expect) from Action Input (with), remove hidden variable injection, define the mohist/opencode Action contract, and migrate all built-in profiles.

tasks.title: Server task contract: Expect field, YAML parsing, legacy validation, and dispatch
tasks.description: Add the Expect field to every server-side shape that carries task definition data (TaskDefinition, TaskRun, WorkflowTaskWork, WorkItem, Orleans surrogates, RuntimeTaskInput, AddTasksBatchItem). Replace FeedbackTaskConfig with TaskDefinition in ApprovalFeedbackConfig. Update the YAML serializer to read and emit top-level expect alongside with. Add Action-aware legacy validation that rejects with.expect and with.agent on mohist/opencode and mohist/acp-agent tasks while leaving Action-owned fields (e.g. mohist/github-pr-status with.expect: merged) valid. Remove the deep-merge branch from TaskWithExpander.Expand and the with.agent synthesis from WorkflowItemTranslator.ResolveWith, keeping only whole-value variable resolution. Add Expect to WorkDispatch and expand it at dispatch time. Update TaskRunExtensions.ExtractRequiredFiles and TaskRun.ToDefinition() to use Expect.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowYamlSerializer round-trips a task with top-level expect beside with, artifacts, setVars, and recovery without losing or merging fields
Loading a mohist/opencode or mohist/acp-agent task with with.expect containing files, markers, or failIf fails with an error naming the task and directing to task-level expect
Loading a mohist/opencode or mohist/acp-agent task with with.agent fails with an error directing to explicit options binding
A mohist/github-pr-status check declaring with.expect: merged loads and dispatches without rejection
TaskWithExpander.Expand performs whole-value ${{ vars.* }} resolution only; a literal with.options object is not deep-merged with a same-named variable object
WorkflowItemTranslator.ResolveWith does not synthesize with.agent from effective vars.agent when the task omits it
WorkDispatch carries Expect as a serialized JSON string; WorkflowItemTranslator.BuildTaskDispatchAsync expands and includes it for task-variant dispatches
TaskRunExtensions.ExtractRequiredFiles reads from the Expect field, not from WithInput['expect']
TaskRun.ToDefinition() includes Expect in the returned TaskDefinition
ApprovalFeedbackConfig uses TaskDefinition; ResolveFeedbackTask returns a TaskDefinition with the full canonical shape
All existing server spec and unit tests pass after updating assertions that locked the old with.expect or deep-merge behavior
tasks.output: Server domain types, YAML serializer, TaskWithExpander, WorkflowItemTranslator, WorkDispatch, and related tests all reflect the separate Expect contract
tasks.notes: Key files: WorkflowDefinition.cs (TaskDefinition, FeedbackTaskConfig), TaskRun.cs (ExtractRequiredFiles, ToDefinition), WorkflowYamlSerializer.cs (ToTask, ToTaskMap, ValidateTaskExpectations), TaskWithExpander.cs (Expand), WorkflowItemTranslator.cs (ResolveWith, BuildTaskDispatchAsync), WorkflowRun.Work.cs (WorkflowTaskWork), WorkItem.cs, IWorkflowGrain.cs (RuntimeTaskInput, AddTasksBatchItem), IRunnerGrain.cs (WorkDispatch), WorkflowDefinitionSurrogates.cs, WorkflowRun.Approval.cs (ResolveFeedbackTask). Orleans Id slots: WorkItem [Id(11)], WorkDispatch [Id(18)].

tasks.title: Model config validation and writer convergence
tasks.description: Change the model ID validation regex in IssueModelMetadata from exactly-one-slash to first-slash-split, so model IDs containing additional slashes (e.g. openrouter/vendor/family/model) are accepted while missing provider or model-ID portions are rejected. Stop adding the type: opencode execution-backend key in MohistIssueWorkflowProfileBase and in the Web IssueModelSelector variable patch calls. These surfaces persist only the model and variant meaning of vars.agent.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueModelMetadata.ValidateModel accepts 'openrouter/vendor/family/model' and returns null (success)
IssueModelMetadata.ValidateModel rejects 'model-only', '/model', and 'provider/' with an actionable provider/model error message
Per-stage model selectors in IssueModelMetadata.Validate apply the same multi-slash acceptance
MohistIssueWorkflowProfileBase no longer writes type: opencode into vars.agent defaults
IssueModelSelector.tsx patchIssueWorkflowDefinitionVar and patchIssueWorkflowStageDefinitionVar calls no longer include type: opencode
Existing IssueModelMetadata unit tests and IssueModelSelector web tests pass after updating assertions that expected the old regex or the type key
tasks.output: IssueModelMetadata.cs regex updated, MohistIssueWorkflowProfileBase.cs type key removed, IssueModelSelector.tsx type key removed, and all related tests updated
tasks.notes: Key files: IssueModelMetadata.cs (ProviderModelFormat regex line 50), Issue/Services/WorkflowProfiles/MohistIssueWorkflowProfileBase.cs (line 89), web/src/features/select-issue-model/ui/IssueModelSelector.tsx (lines 250, 268, 304, 347, 349). This task is independent of the task-contract work — it touches the Issue model-config surface, not the Workflow task declaration.

tasks.title: Runner completion evaluator, output projection, and dispatch contract
tasks.description: Add expect to runner types (WorkDispatchResponse, RenderedWorkItem, AddTaskInput) and parse it in connection.ts. Add a private turnFact field to the internal ActionResult type for carrying the final assistant text without serializing it into WorkItemResult. Move the file/marker/failIf/_output completion evaluator from the acp-agent Action into the Workflow task executor as a new step between Action normalization and recovery. For mohist/opencode tasks, project the public output to null or { promise: value } based on whether a promise marker matched; preserve all other Actions' output unchanged. Update the executor step ordering so completion evaluation and output projection run before recovery. Update recovery.ts tryRecovery to copy expect into self-retry tasks. Update template.ts literal field paths for standalone expect rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: RenderedWorkItem and AddTaskInput carry expect; connection.ts toWorkItem parses expect from the dispatch response
ActionResult has an optional turnFact field that is never serialized into WorkItemResult.output
The executor evaluates top-level expect after the Action returns and before recovery matching, reading from the expanded expect rather than from ActionContext.with
A task whose Action succeeds but whose expect.files entry is missing fails with a message identifying the missing path
A file-backed marker with oneOf [PASS, FAIL] matches the first present value in declaration order when the file contains both
An _output marker matches the last accepted occurrence in the final assistant text and generalizes beyond lowercase done/unfinished to arbitrary <promise>VALUE</promise> values
When no turnFact.finalAssistantText is available, an _output marker is unsatisfied and the executor does not fall back to Action Output
mohist/opencode task output is null when no promise marker matched, and { promise: VALUE } when one matched
A non-agent Action (e.g. mohist/rebase) returning structured output preserves that output unchanged through completion evaluation
tryRecovery copies expect into the self-retry AddTaskInput alongside with, recovery, and recoveryRemaining
template.ts LITERAL_FIELD_PATHS protects markers.*.contains and markers.*.oneOf.* when rendering expect as a standalone object
Runner spec and unit tests pass; tests that locked the old Action-private verifyExpectations or acp-agent output shape are updated
tasks.output: Runner executor with Workflow-owned completion evaluation, _output private fact channel, promise output projection, updated recovery self-retry, and all related tests
tasks.notes: Key files: runner/src/core/types.ts (WorkDispatchResponse, RenderedWorkItem, AddTaskInput, ActionResult, WorkItemResult), runner/src/server/connection.ts (toWorkItem, report), runner/src/runtime/executor.ts (executeOne step ordering), runner/src/actions/expectations.ts (move to executor-owned, generalize parseLastMarker), runner/src/runtime/recovery.ts (tryRecovery self-retry), runner/src/core/template.ts (LITERAL_FIELD_PATHS). The turnFact is runner-internal only; it is dropped at the ActionResult→WorkItemResult boundary.

tasks.title: mohist/opencode bridge handler and openspec task generator
tasks.description: Register a mohist/opencode Action handler in the runner that accepts the new input shape (prompt, session, options), validates it (non-empty prompt, string options.model/variant, first-slash model parsing), delegates turn execution to the existing ACP runtime underneath, populates turnFact.finalAssistantText, and does not evaluate expect or append variant as a slash segment. Remove expectation evaluation and implicit repair-turn logic from the acp-agent path. Update openspec.ts to default generated task uses to mohist/opencode and propagate expect from the task template through mergeTaskWith.
acceptanceCriteria: mohist/opencode is registered in the Action registry and resolves to a handler function
The handler accepts with.prompt, with.session, and with.options and does not require agent, kind, or type
The handler rejects a missing or blank prompt before starting a turn
The handler validates that options.model and options.variant are strings when present and rejects non-string values
The handler splits options.model at the first slash to derive provider and model ID without appending variant as a segment
The handler populates turnFact.finalAssistantText from the completed turn and does not include expect evaluation
The acp-agent Action no longer calls verifyExpectations or performs an implicit expectation-repair turn
openspec.ts openspecTasksAction defaults to uses: mohist/opencode when the profile does not specify a uses
openspec.ts mergeTaskWith propagates expect from the task template into the generated AddTaskInput
Runner tests cover the opencode handler input validation, turn delegation, turnFact population, and openspec generator default uses
tasks.output: Registered mohist/opencode bridge handler, cleaned acp-agent path, updated openspec task generator, and related runner tests
tasks.notes: Key files: runner/src/actions/registry.ts (register mohist/opencode), runner/src/actions/acp-agent.ts (remove verifyExpectations call, remove implicit repair), runner/src/actions/acp/session-strategies.ts (remove expectationRepairLimit default turn), runner/src/actions/acp/agent-config.ts (accept options instead of agent), runner/src/actions/acp/model-resolution.ts (first-slash split, no variant append), runner/src/actions/openspec.ts (defaultUses, mergeTaskWith). The bridge handler delegates to the existing ACP runtime; native OpenCode SDK implementation is a sibling issue in epic 46.

tasks.title: Built-in profile migration and design doc alignment
tasks.description: Migrate both built-in workflow YAML profiles (mohist-local, mohist/github-pr) to the canonical task contract: switch all agent tasks from mohist/acp-agent to mohist/opencode, move with.expect declarations to top-level expect, change agent: ${{ vars.agent }} to options: ${{ vars.agent }}, remove variables.agent.type, and add options: ${{ vars.agent }} to the apply-feedback approval task. Apply the same transformation to all nested recovery and self-retry tasks. Update design/workflow/actions.md, design/workflow/task-dispatch.md, and design/workflow/builtin-workflows.md to reflect the migrated contract and remove stale current-state notes.
acceptanceCriteria: Both built-in profiles load without legacy-validation errors after migration
No agent task in either profile uses mohist/acp-agent or contains with.agent
No agent task in either profile contains Workflow completion policy under with.expect
All former with.expect declarations appear as top-level expect beside with, artifacts, setVars, or recovery
All agent tasks bind options: ${{ vars.agent }} instead of agent: ${{ vars.agent }}
variables.agent in both profiles contains no type key or other execution-backend discriminator
The apply-feedback task in both profiles declares options: ${{ vars.agent }}
Stage order, approval points, Action-owned inputs (e.g. github-pr-status with.expect: merged), artifacts, setVars, recovery budgets, and handler ordering are unchanged
Previously discarded top-level expect declarations in mohist/github-pr (proposal, design, tasks) are retained and will be enforced
design/workflow/actions.md describes mohist/opencode input/output contract and task-level expect without stale ACP references
design/workflow/builtin-workflows.md reflects the migrated agent task shape
Profile loading and workflow spec tests pass after migration
tasks.output: Migrated mohist-local.workflow.yaml, mohist-github-pr.workflow.yaml, updated design docs, and passing profile tests
tasks.notes: Key files: server/src/Mohist.Server/Workflow/Services/Profiles/mohist-local.workflow.yaml, mohist-github-pr.workflow.yaml, design/workflow/actions.md, design/workflow/task-dispatch.md, design/workflow/builtin-workflows.md. The mohist/github-pr-status check's with.expect: merged is an Action-owned input and must NOT be moved to top-level expect. Recovery tasks (e.g. recover:fix-tests with _output marker) move their with.expect to top-level expect.
